---
title: "Expression_labeling_merge"
author: "Andrew Becker"
output: html_document
date: "2025-12-12"
R_version: "4.4.2"
description: "Merges proximity labeling data with expression data from two independent experiments. Performs ANCOVA to identify proteins with altered proximity while controlling for expression changes, and generates bubble plots, scatter plots, and waterfall plots."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- SETUP: Load required libraries and define paths ---
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(pbapply)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# --- LOAD CONFIGURATION ---
source(here::here("src", "config.R"))

# --- Hardcoded Box paths (note: future work to centralize in src/config.R) ---
box_root <- "C:/Users/andbp/Box/Backus_Lab/Andrew_Becker/ABecker_Lab_Notebook/R_WD"
ref_dir  <- file.path(box_root, "Reference_dbs")
exp1_dir <- file.path(box_root, "AP2-339_HAECs_DF-UF_ALOD4_OLyA", "01_Input_Search_Results")
exp2_dir <- file.path(box_root, "AP2-327_HAEC-expression", "01_Input_Search_Results")
output_dir <- file.path(box_root, "POCA2", "03_graphs_plots")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r data_loading}
# --- DATA LOADING ---
# Read results files (as .csv)

# 1. Read file with gene names and UniProt IDs (accession #s). Use "primary gene names"!
# Note: UniProt lookup pattern is a candidate for extraction to src/functions.R
df.labels <- read_excel(file.path(ref_dir, "uniprot_hs_29may25.xlsx"))
lookup <- df.labels[, c("ProteinID", "Gene")]

# 2. Read experiment result files
df1.comparison <- read.csv(file.path(exp1_dir, "339B-top4-features_comparison-results_imputed.csv"))
df1.protein <-read.csv(file.path(exp1_dir, "339B-top4-features_protein-level-data_impute.csv"))
df2.comparison <- read.csv(file.path(exp2_dir, "327-normalized_top4-features_comparison-results_imputed.csv"))
df2.protein <- read.csv(file.path(exp2_dir, "327-normalized_top4-features_protein-level-data_impute.csv"))

# 3. Define target proteins for highlighting in plots
highlight_targets <- TRUE
target_file_path <- here::here("data", "target_proteins_296-ALOD4.csv")
```

```{r data_processing}
# --- DATA PROCESSING: Filter and prepare comparison data ---
source(here::here("src", "functions.R"))

# 1. Define the prefixes/suffixes that define different cell states
# "negative" = The denominator in foldchange calculation (first in string)
# "positive" = The numerator in foldchange calculation (second in string)
denom_state <- "UF" 
num_state   <- "DF"

# 2. Filter Experiment 1 (Treatments), hardcoding the ALOD4/OlyA mixed comparisons
df1_clean <- df1.comparison %>% mutate(Condition = case_when(Label == "ALOD4DF_vs_ALOD4UF" ~ "ALOD4_DF-vs-UF", Label == "OlyADF_vs_OlyAUF" ~ "OlyA_DF-vs-UF", Label == "OlyADF_vs_ALOD4UF" ~ "OlyA-DF vs ALOD4-UF", Label == "ALOD4DF_vs_OlyAUF" ~ "ALOD4-DF vs OlyA-UF", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% filter(!is.na(Condition)) %>% select(Protein, Condition, log2FC, pvalue, adj.pvalue)

# 3. Filter Experiment 2 (Expression)
df2_clean <- df2.comparison %>%
  filter(Label == "DF_vs_UF") %>%
  mutate(Condition = "Control")
```

```{r data_processing_merge}
# --- DATA PROCESSING: Merge expression data onto labeling data ---
# 1. Prepare Reference (Compact Version)
df_expression_ref <- df2_clean %>%
  select(Protein, log2FC, pvalue, adj.pvalue) %>%
  rename(expr_log2FC = log2FC, expr_pvalue = pvalue, expr_adj_pvalue = adj.pvalue)

# 2. Join (Compact Version)
df_combined_fc <- df1_clean %>% left_join(df_expression_ref, by = "Protein") %>% relocate(Protein, Condition, log2FC, expr_log2FC, .after = 0)

# 3. Check
head(df_combined_fc)
```

```{r visualization}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Plot expression/labeling foldchanges ---
source(here::here("src", "plot_labeling_vs_expression_colors.R"))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Labeling_vs_normExpression_bubble-plot_labels_14Feb26_14x12.pdf"), plot = p_fc, width = 12, height = 14)
```

```{r analysis}
# --- ANALYSIS: Multiple linear regression (ANCOVA) at protein level ---
# Replicate-level protein ANCOVA, mean expression intensity used as covariate
source(here::here("src", "protein_anova_analysis.R")) 
# Scatter plot of ANCOVA results
source(here::here("src", "plot_ancova_scatter.R"))
# Waterfall plot of ANCOVA results
source(here::here("src", "plot_ancova_waterfall.R"))
```

```{r export_plots}
# --- EXPORT: Save ANCOVA plots ---
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "HAEC_expression-labeling_ANCOVA-scatter_JJMack-labels.pdf"), plot = p_scatter, width = 6, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "ANCOVA_Waterfall.pdf"), plot = p_water, width = 10, height = 6)
```
